notes.title: Price drop and Update 1.16.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34949843/c37598e411c2bda2cbc3f0bfa0ee35ecaf4da8ad.png[/img]

[b]I have dropped the price from $5.99 to $1.99, and I have uploaded a new update.

Release notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some textures have been redone.
[*] Godot Engine has been updated to version 3.2
[*] Fixed a bug where an animation could be triggered twice on the final boss
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34949843/47cd201c7e43d36f9323e713fe3b0cc81467bea6.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34949843/785ba2099c37dcf172d9a363bddd539130dff855.png[/img]

Release notes:
    Revamped the user interface
    Fixed issue of double input on some menu buttons when clicked with a mouse
    Fixed issue where mouse clicks were getting blocked on some menu buttons
    Fixed issue with flickering graphics on some nvidia cards
    Updated the Godot Engine
    Fixed issue where the players ship would slow down when moved along window border
    Added some additional sound effects
    Code and resource cleanup
    Fixed issue where the level 6 loading screen would not play properly


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34949843/765572a5d56519d11f75fb64a0ab9e37a4420ff6.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
Release notes:
- Added new loading screens showing the ship heading to the next destination, that can be skipped by pressing the accept button
- Fixed UI button highlights not appearing on older hardware


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34949843/6663b42f8460654e4d906320e6d382794a28407f.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1 Local Multiplayer update.
notes.content:
Release notes:
- local multiplayer co-op with up to four players
- An additional playable ship
- User interface updates
- Better backwards compatibility for GLES2 capable computers
- A loss of life no longer restarts the level
- Additional ending for the new ship
- Added a lower grade pulse attack, and changed the way the main ship is downgraded when attacked. 
- Various bug fixes 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34949843/94d8f813e2135b507b0f83e7f49784a1e70682a2.png[/img]
